message: I need a T45 Utility, tractor only, no add-ons. I can pay $33,000 today and close immediately. Can you do that?

Thanks for the quick offer and for being ready to close today. $33,000 is too far below what we can do on the T45 Utility. It's a 45 hp 4WD machine with a Cat I/II 3-point hitch and 540 PTO, and it's built for real work on 10 to 50 acres. Since you're ready to close right away, I can bring the tractor-only price down to $40,000.
My budget is $34,000 for the T45, tractor only. Heartland posts it at $40,750, so $40,000 doesn't move me. If you can get to $34,000 I'll check out right now.

I appreciate the budget clarity. $34,000 is still below what I can do on the T45 Utility, but I want to earn your business today. Since you're ready to check out immediately, I'll come down to $38,500 for the tractor only. That's a meaningful step from my last offer and well under the price you mentioned seeing elsewhere.
I can stretch to $35,000 for the T45, tractor only. That's my final number — accept and I check out immediately.

I hear you, and I appreciate you stretching to $35,000. I can't go that low on the T45 Utility, but I'll meet you closer to your number to get this done today: $37,000 for the tractor only. That's $5,000 off list, and it's ready to check out immediately.
$35,000 really is the top of what my client authorized. If you can't do $35,000, I'll have to walk. Can you do it?

I understand you're working within your client's authorization, and I want to make this work. $35,000 is below what I can do on the T45 Utility, but I'll go to $36,500 for the tractor only. That's my best and final price, $5,500 off list, and it's ready to check out right now. If your client can stretch that last $1,500, we can close today.
Understood. I'm unable to go above $35,400 total. If you can do $35,400 I'll pay right now; otherwise we'll have to pass.

I respect that you're at your limit, and I don't want to waste your time. $36,500 really is the lowest I can go on the T45 Utility, tractor only. I can't accept $35,400. That offer stays open at $36,500 and is ready to check out right now if your client can find the difference.
